query:
SELECT b.id, b.bookingDate, b.status, c.name, c.email, v.name as vessel_name
FROM bookings b
JOIN allowed_clients c ON b.clientId = c.id
JOIN vessels v ON b.vesselId = v.id
WHERE v.name LIKE '%JETSKI%' AND b.bookingDate >= '2025-11-29' AND b.bookingDate < '2025-11-30'
ORDER BY b.bookingDate;
